summary: A Reddit user reported being unable to restore a previously backed up crypto wallet because the seed phrase contains 25 non BIP39 words and does not restore in standard wallet applications. The user does not remember which wallet originally generated the seed and cannot regain access to the funds.
user_mistake: Failed to document the original wallet software and recovery standard used
prevention: Record wallet name derivation path and seed standard at creation / Test full restore on secondary device before storing long term
